lines.en: I move in a series of little jerks.

lines.zh: 大触角划水，把我推出去。
lines.en: My long antennae row me forward.
My shell comes in two halves.
You can see the water moving inside me.
I hang, then dart upward.

lines.zh: 我从两片叶子之间弹过。
lines.en: I spring between two leaves.
I settle on a stem.
The current shifts and I drift with it.

lines.zh: 我用后端的爪扒着叶面。
lines.en: My rear claws grip the leaf.
On the stem, I spring off again.
My movements are small and quick.

lines.zh: 我从一群同类中穿过去。
lines.en: I thread through a swarm.

lines.zh: 我从同类中穿过去，换了水层。
lines.en: Threading the swarm, I change depth.
I sink beside the roots.
I turn under the surface.

lines.zh: 我找到一个安静的角落。
lines.en: I find a quiet corner.

lines.zh: 寻到一处静水，我停下来。
lines.en: In a quiet corner, I stop.
After a while, I spring again.
After a while I hang there, filtering.
My appendages keep rowing.
Water flows between the two halves.
My shell is thin. I'm almost transparent.

lines.zh: 水从两瓣之间过，我慢慢转着。
lines.en: Water flows between the halves. I turn slowly.
My kin nearby filter too.
We keep the same rhythm.
My antenna brushes a stem.
A tiny creature swims by.

lines.zh: 小虫从边上过去，我懒得去追。
lines.en: A tiny thing drifts by. I can't be bothered.
A hint of iron enters the water.
I slowly turn with the current.
I open and close my shell slowly.
I'll stay at this depth.
I hang in your shadow.
One move from you and the water churns.
I spring a short way off.
I back off a little, then return.
I'm too small; you probably can't see me.

lines.zh: 你的手指伸进来，我贴着水草。
lines.en: Your fingers enter. I cling to the weed.
Your fingers enter the water.
The fingers come. I go around them.
I watch from beside.

lines.zh: 我悬在一边，水面重新定住。
lines.en: Hanging aside, I watch the surface settle.
One antenna is bent.
I'm spun around.
One antenna is down to a stub.

lines.zh: 半截触角没了，我胡乱弹个不停。
lines.en: Half an antenna gone. I spring about wildly.
Springing hard, I hide in the weed.
My own scent spreads in the water.

lines.zh: 水里散着我的气味，我缓缓定住。
lines.en: My scent is in the water. I slowly steady.
After that, I can still move.

lines.zh: 壳上开了细缝，疼得厉害。
lines.en: A fine crack in my shell. It hurts.
I hold the stem, still.

lines.zh: 水里浮着些极细的颗粒。
lines.en: Fine particles drift in the water.

lines.zh: 水里有东西，我滤了一口。
lines.en: Something in the water. I filter a mouthful.

lines.zh: 这一口滤下来，味道可以。
lines.en: This mouthful tastes fine.
Not bad. Another mouthful.
This mouthful will keep me filtering a while.

lines.zh: 又吸一口，我便绕了个弯。
lines.en: Another mouthful, and I veer.
A full loop, and the water's murky.
The water clouds. I stop.
I stop and wait for it to clear.
I settle downward in slow stages.
The water knocks me over.
It takes several springs to steady.
Knocked over, mud on my shell.
Mud on my shell. I shake.
I shake and spring back.
Your movements are too violent.
I spring behind a frond.

lines.zh: 躲在水草后，水慢慢清了。
lines.en: Behind the weed, the water clears.
I peek out of the gap.
It's clear and quiet here.
There are many of my kind here.
Our scents mix.
I approach one of them.
Its shell is thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把细小的东西留在水里。
lines.en: We leave tiny things in the water.
They'll grow on their own.
After prying it open, I spring away.
I spring off, back to the weed.
Back at the weed, I filter on.
The water is as busy as ever.
I nudge it with my antennae.

lines.zh: 触角一拨，那东西竟比我大。
lines.en: My antennae nudge it. It's bigger than me.
Bigger than me. I can't push it.
I can't move it. I go around.
I draw in water and strain it.

lines.zh: 这一口滤下来，留下了东西。
lines.en: This mouthful leaves something behind.
It sinks; I let go.

lines.zh: 尝着不对劲，我照样留着它。
lines.en: It tastes wrong. I keep it anyway.
Not good. I spit it out.
I spring back onto the weed.
I spring aside. The water moved.
The water shifts. I spring aside.
Springing aside, I see it's large.

lines.zh: 那影子不小，我收起触角。
lines.en: The shape is big. I fold my antennae.
The weed gives some cover.

lines.zh: 水草替我遮着，它始终没沉下。
lines.en: The weed covers me. It never comes down.
It hasn't come down. It's still above.
Still above. I don't move.
I don't move. Wait for it to go.
The water is still. All right.
I spring clear, and it stays close.
It's still near. I press to the stem.

lines.zh: 我通体透明，它就掠过去了。
lines.en: I'm nearly clear. It swims past.

lines.zh: 它掠过去了，我候水势平。
lines.en: It sweeps past. I wait for calm.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃，我慢慢松开。
lines.en: Light wavers above. I slowly let go.
I return among my kin.
We filter together.
Nothing happened.

lines.zh: 同族和我一道过滤，接着干。
lines.en: My kin and I filter together. Carry on.
I quietly change depth.
I spring out and bump into it.
That force doesn't even stir the water.
One bump and I spring off.
I slap with an antenna.

lines.zh: 触角甩过去，它连动都没动。
lines.en: An antenna slap, and it doesn't react.
No reaction. I flee.
The swarm scatters.
We're everywhere in the water.
I hide at the weed's roots.

lines.zh: 缩到草根间，我一点点平复。
lines.en: At the weed's roots, I slowly recover.
A tiny speck appears in the water.
My shell is still soft; I filter first.
My kin's scent is in the water.

lines.zh: 水里全是同族的气味，我弹了弹。
lines.en: The water smells of kin. I spring once.
I settle into a new layer of water.

lines.zh: 我往那边游，水草正摇晃不停。
lines.en: I head over. The weed is swaying.
The weed sways. I settle on a stem.

lines.zh: 我停在草茎上，水清得见底。
lines.en: On the stem, the water is clear.
Clear water. I can live here.

lines.zh: 这地方能安身，我开始滤食。
lines.en: I can live here. I start filtering.

lines.zh: 水变热了，我拼命往下钻。
lines.en: The water warms and I dive.

lines.zh: 我被摔出水面，又落回去。
lines.en: I'm thrown from the water and fall back.
In water, and I can't breathe.
The blast sweeps me far.

lines.zh: 箭尖破水而下，把我掀了过来。
lines.en: An arrowhead splits the surface and flips me.
Light sets the water still.

lines.zh: 滤了半天，什么也没剩下。
lines.en: I strain and strain, and get nothing.
Current runs through the water and I lock up.
The water is gone; I spin in the dark.
